problem_type: Unowned keyboard reverse actions overwrite unrelated later editing
symptom: Hidden storyboard or Redo restores deleted rows; later edits are overwritten; legacy restoration pops unrelated canvas history.
direct_cause: Window listener omits event ownership and restores whole plan plus N current global undo barriers. Moving ownership to the editor root initially left focus at body when deletion removed the focused menu button.
class_root: Reverse actions lack surface ownership and mutation-scoped authority.
affected_population: Legacy and Run original storyboard hosts; single/multi-row deletion, delayed confirmation and later author edits
entry_points: Original row menu and multi-selection deletion
internal_only_reason: Reuses installed React DOM event boundary, original canvas input predicate and original graph compensation; no new framework API.
invariants: Only an unconsumed ordinary Undo from the visible editor DOM may reverse deletion.
Deletion restoration preserves later plan fields and existing graph identities/results.
Ambiguous legacy row correspondence or changed deletion target fails visibly.
After deletion removes the focused editor control, restore editor focus only while focus remains unowned on body; never steal a live sibling or input focus.

door_reduction.why_not: Original workspace host mounts, editor writes, canvas override edits, Agent tool application, shot-table edits and onboarding are distinct authorized producers. Existing proposal compensation and local storyboard deletion reuse restoreGraph for different domains; event ownership and reverse semantics converge in the editor/helper rather than deleting these necessary callers.

generality_proof: Both storage hosts mount the same editor and both deletion UI doors converge on its identity-checked local reverse action.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own keyboard event ancestry and exact delayed deletion target.
Apply only the original deletion inverse to the latest plan and graph.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Original component handles delete/Undo for legacy store.
Run adapter renders the same editor with original host.change.

recurrence.reason: Both hosts preserve mounted editing state across workspace changes and allow edits after deletion.
same_class_scan: door-map StoryboardPlanEditor and setStoryboardPlan; StoryboardShotTable row/multi delete callbacks; useCanvasShortcuts event ownership; canvasUndoJournal and restoreGraph/moveNodeToGroup.

prevention.invariant: Only the actual visible editor consumes Undo; local inverse cannot rewind unrelated content.
prevention.failure_mode: Ignore foreign shortcut; report original inline failure on stale or ambiguous deletion target.
prevention.strategy: Remove global listener and whole-snapshot restoration, reuse domain graph compensation with one transaction barrier.

legacy_paths.rationale: Removes window undo listener, old complete-plan snapshot and blind canvasSteps pop loop.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Application shortcut and deletion ownership, no third-party defect or new API.

migration: No persisted schema or legacy stable-ID migration; ambiguous legacy correspondence is rejected.
residual_risks: Full Electron shell/cold persistence verification pending.

invariant_owner_layer.rationale: The original editor is the common mutation and event boundary for both storage hosts.
